statements.status_notes: CVE-2025-30258: before the fix, importing a certificate with crafted subkey data that lacks a valid back-signature or has incorrect usage flags stops gpg from verifying signatures made by certain other signing keys (a verification denial of service). GnuPG tracked it as https://dev.gnupg.org/T7527 and fixed it on master (rG48978ccb4e20) and on the 2.4 branch (rGda0164efc7f3), both titled 'gpg: Fix a verification DoS due to a malicious subkey in the keyring.' The fix first shipped in GnuPG 2.4.8, whose release notes list it under T7527 (https://dev.gnupg.org/T7428), and in 2.5.5. Debian lists trixie 2.4.7-21+deb13u1 as fixed (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2025-30258). This owner builds the upstream GnuPG release tarball. Its only published build in the DHI Alpine 3.23 repository is 2.4.9-r0, on x86_64 and aarch64. We read the gpg binary from that build on both architectures, and it reports version 2.4.9, which is later than 2.4.8. Every published build carries the fix, so the range closes at 2.4.9-r0.
